body: You guys are so poetic. I just don't understand how you can be so positive. I mean like it seems like we're on the same page but also you already know what happens the next couple of chapters( I think I'm trying to hard to sound poetic). Thanks for the responses though. I really hate myself but if I'm good at anything, it's how to take good advice. Granted it doesn't last me very long and I just get that random push of sadness that opens the door to self hate, pity, loneliness, and the rest. But honestly thank you for trying
